prospect_discovery.source_semantic_filter: directory-provider self domains and obvious institutional/navigation candidates are rejected; category drift fails closed

prospect_qualification.score_contract: ICP 0-3 + evidence-bound agent opportunity 0-3 + active signal 0-2 + value/integration fit 0-2; A=8-10, B=6-7, C=0-5
quality_rules: one primary agent opportunity is selected instead of stacking generic opportunities
A requires an official-page evidence-bound fact and agent idea
generic contact-only evidence stays hold without stronger fit/signal
fetch/evidence failures become UNSCORED hold instead of fabricated rejection
agency/provider and self targets fail closed
qualification never creates compliance or send permission

zero_touch_prepare.flow: prospect_discovery -> prospect_candidate_sanitizer -> prospect_signal_discovery -> prospect_agent_qualification -> contact_enrichment -> prospect_intelligence -> private_outreach_config -> outreach_agent_prepare
zero_touch_prepare.input_boundary: only A-qualified ai_agent prospects with ContactCandidates.ready can produce agent copy
zero_touch_prepare.private_config_contract: US postal address is loaded from a private service-account-readable config source; queue copy stores only the private postal placeholder
zero_touch_prepare.queue_contract: writes status=prepared, compliance_status=manual_review and blank compliance_basis; stale automated agent rows reconcile to manual_review; never creates approved/sendable state
zero_touch_prepare.copy_contract: deterministic NL/EN agent copy with one canonical follow-up, no inferred agent price and no unsupported result claim

sender_readiness.provider_managed_relay: provider_managed may be used for a proven shared mijn.host relay without claiming fixed-IP reputation or global placement

outreach_delivery.private_config_contract: the physical postal address is loaded privately and injected only at send time; it is not persisted in public queue copy
outreach_delivery.live_gate: sender_readiness -> website target/evidence -> LeadPromo copy -> compliance -> SMTP
outreach_delivery.target_evidence_contract: approved rows accept canonical agent_offer:<JSON> with same-domain evidence_url, exact fact/idea, approved agent_type, business_process and KPI candidate; legacy website_scan:<JSON> remains accepted for already-prepared website/webshop rows
outreach_delivery.international_copy_contract: controlled NL and EN copy only; CTA/opt-out/signature language may not be mixed
outreach_delivery.us_gate: US requires private physical postal configuration plus commercial identification; queue holds only the postal placeholder
outreach_delivery.uk_gate: GB unsolicited route requires subscriber_type=corporate evidence plus clear Ltd/Limited/LLP/PLC company form; uncertainty blocks

scanner_tools.trigger_when: explicit website audit or Leads technical evidence-gap crawl orchestration is needed
explicit audit or Leads technical evidence-gap desktop/mobile browser evidence is needed
supplemental link signals are needed for the scoped evidence question
performance context is the scoped evidence question
technology context is necessary to interpret the scoped evidence question
a completed explicit audit or evidence-gap scan returns to Leads

boundaries: Leadscanner executes bounded Leads policy; it is not a second process controller.
AI agent sales is the default new-offer family; legacy website/webshop evidence remains compatibility-only.
The six approved agent types are front_desk_sales, lead_reactivation, review_concierge, customer_support, commerce and quote_intake.
Official-site evidence selects one primary agent opportunity; no missed-call, workload, revenue or ROI claim is invented.
Prospect qualification can change Customer Potential state but never compliance or send permission.
Agent prepare writes only prepared/manual_review rows with blank compliance_basis and no mailbox credentials.
The live target-evidence gate accepts agent_offer evidence and legacy website_scan evidence, then rechecks the official homepage before SMTP.
US physical postal configuration remains private and is injected at send time; queue copy stores the placeholder only.
NL/EER live outreach still requires a separately evidenced valid compliance basis.
Reply, bounce and opt-out readback stop follow-up state and maintain suppression evidence.
No secret belongs in repository files, Sheet evidence fields, logs, test fixtures or artifacts.
